artworks.title: The Balcony
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an old architectural facade facing a canal, resembling Venetian scenery. The focus is on the building's entrance and the waterline. The artwork uses intricate etching with fine lines, crosshatching, and stippling for texture. It has a monochromatic palette of sepia tones. There is a small boat near the building, and a figure at the entrance. In the background, there are architectural elements and figures on a balcony.

A person is seated at the bottom of the stairs with their feet in a water-like surface. Further up, two figures can be seen standing within a shadowy archway. The brushstrokes are delicate and sketch-like, with fine lines creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic warm sepia. The walls around the doorway are rough and overgrown.

In the distance, a tower-like building with an ornate top can be seen. The artwork has a sketch-like quality with light etching strokes, and a monochromatic palette of sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Rialto
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a monochromatic sketch of a busy urban street scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a view from above. Tall buildings line the street, leading towards a prominent tower in the distance. Fine lines depict the texture of the architecture and people moving in the scene. The color palette is limited to sepia tones, creating a vintage feel. People, horses, and carriages are shown in fluid, sketch-like strokes, adding to the lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Long Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of a city along a waterfront with classical architecture and sailing ships. The horizon line is in the center of the composition, emphasizing the water with reflections of buildings and ships. The etching features delicate brushstrokes creating motion in the clouds and a monochromatic palette of sepia and black. Architectural elements and masts rise into the sky, while the horizon adds depth to the scene.

The buildings depict architectural details like balconies and arched doorways. The artwork is in the form of a detailed etching with fine lines showing the texture of the buildings and canal waters. The color palette is sepia, creating contrast between light and shadow. A gondola with a gondolier is gliding along the canal, while another gondola rests against the wall. artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene featuring an alleyway and architectural elements. The drawing shows a view of a street, leading through an archway to an alley. In the foreground, steps lead down into the scene, with architectural details framing the path. The alley is bustling with activity. The etched lines are fine and closely woven, creating detailed textures reflecting the stonework and woodwork of buildings. The architecture includes a visible facade with an arch and inner rooms seen through large openings resembling windows, giving a glimpse of objects or furnishings inside. The overall tone of the drawing is muted with a focus on light and shadows capturing the mood of a historical city street.

artworks.title: Wheelwright

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered, rustic interior with various objects and structures. The drawing depicts the inside of a large barn or workshop. Wooden beams stretch across the ceiling, with details of wheels, planks, and boards in the foreground. On the right, there are shapes resembling tools, benches, or storage areas. The composition has strong perspective, emphasizing shadows and forms with a hatching technique. The style suggests an artist interested in structure and detail.

artworks.title: Temple

artworks.description: The etching displays a street view featuring a large, multi-storied building. The perspective is slightly angled, enhancing the depth. The horizon is not prominent, as the buildings extend vertically. A horse-drawn cart is in front of the building, with a gas lamp nearby. A tree is on the right. The brushstrokes are subtle and minimalistic. The color scheme is monochromatic, using the paper's tone and black ink for contrast. Additional faintly sketched buildings appear in the distance.

The color palette is monochromatic with natural tones of paper and dark ink lines.

artworks.title: Little Court

The composition is minimalistic, focusing on form and layout rather than intricate details. The use of lines is loose, giving the impression of a rapid sketch or an etching.

artworks.title: Drury Lane

Sketched figures are in the foreground, while more figures are seen in the distance near the buildings.

artworks.title: Regent's Quadrant
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a busy urban street scene with carriages and individuals. The vantage point is low, showing a large overhanging structure supported by a column on the left side. Horizontal lines dominate the upper quarter of the image, and there is no distinct horizon visible. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, with expressive cross-hatching and dynamic lines capturing the energy of the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing black, brown, and beige tones. Figures and carriages are detailed with an impressionistic touch, creating a lively urban setting. In the distance, more buildings and activity are suggested, showing the vibrancy of city life.

artworks.title: Regent's Quadrant

The style is sketch-like, with expressive line work portraying movement and life. Fine lines and hatching depict figures and carriages throughout the scene. Close to us, there are sketchy people and carriages with quick, fluid strokes. In the distance, more figures and a building can be seen. The horizon is hidden by the architectural element at the top. The color palette is sepia.

artworks.title: The Smithy
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper

The studio has a high, slanting roof textured with cross-hatching lines. A large window on the left side lets in light, illuminating the space. Items such as tables, chairs, easels, and artworks are present. The room appears busy and chaotic with many sketchy lines creating a sense of creativity. Delicate shading adds depth and detail to the scene.
